title: veronica alpina subsp. pumila
intro: Veronica alpina subsp. pumila, commonly known as alpine speedwell, is a low-growing, perennial plant species native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Veronica alpina subsp. pumila include soothing irritated skin, reducing fever, and acting as a diuretic. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, are responsible for its medicinal properties.
